description: Department of Local Government - Provincil Council of Sabaragamuwa Province Rules.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment of legal/regulatory frameworks by declaring that specific accounting standards (Public Sector Accounting Standard of Sri Lanka for Local Government Authorities - 2017) must be applied to Pradeshiya Sabhas, Urban Councils, and Municipal Councils in Sabaragamuwa Province. It references specific sections of existing acts and ordinances (Pradeshiya Sabhas Act No. 15 of 1987, Urban Council Ordinance, Municipal Council Ordinance) and creates binding regulatory requirements for financial administration, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
